newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dunlop India chairman sees higher net.
newsitem.headline: Dunlop India chairman sees higher net.

text.p: Dunlop India Chairman Manohar Chhabria said on Wednesday he expected the company to lift net profit for the financial year to end-March 1997 to between 450 million and 500 million rupees.
"It should be in the range of 450-500 million rupees for 1996/97," he told Reuters in an interview in Dubai, where he is based.

Dunlop India, a Calcutta-based company, is one of the country's leading tyre makers. It made a 390 million rupee net profit in the 15 months to March 31, 1996 versus 125.6 million rupees in calendar 1994.
In the six months to end-September 1996 it made a net profit of 185.2 million rupees.
